text:
Jackie (Sales): Hey team — NewBank legal + procurement are asking for SOC 2 Type II report, ISO 27001 cert, and a signed pen-test attestation for a 3-week Dedicated POC. They also want an itemized cost for the POC license and any surge capacity for load testing. Need a reply by EOD PT. Any blockers?

Devon (Eng): Which model and expected throughput? If they want Dedicated GPUs we need RPS/concurrency to size the pool.

Marta (Security): We can share the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted AOC) and the ISO certificate today. For pen-test: we provide a signed attestation letter stating we undergo annual third-party pentests and adherence to remediation timelines. We do not share full pentest reports without an NDA.

Alex (Solutions): I'll bundle: SOC2-AOC.pdf, ISO27001-cert.pdf, pen-test-attestation.pdf (signed by CISO), minimal network diagram, and a short KMS/key-management summary. I'll upload to a secure link.

Jackie (Sales): Nice — realistic turnaround?

Marta (Security): SOC2 AOC + ISO cert (redacted) — 6–12 hours to generate and get approvals. Pen-test attestation — I can sign and return within 48 hours if we use our standard template. If they insist on vendor-signed report or full findings, procurement/legal will need an NDA and that adds days.

sec-bot: Artifact upload task queued.

sec-bot: Artifact upload complete: https://artifacts.redwood.com/links/pocevidence/nb-1767777777 (expires in 14 days) :link: :lock: 

Devon (Eng): Pricing quick note: for a 3-week Dedicated POC sized at roughly 2x p4d-equivalent hosts (to match their expected load) + 100k tokens/day, we can offer a 30% trial discount off list. If they require burst capacity for load testing, include a surge line item. Need model (e.g., Llama-3 / Redwood-v1) to finalize perf/pricing.

Jackie (Sales): Can someone produce a simple quote line-item I can attach to the SOW? Procurement asked for cost breakdown and payment terms.

Alex (Solutions): Draft numbers for initial email (internal draft):
```
- Dedicated POC (3 weeks), 2 x p4d-equivalent hosts: List $18,000 -> Trial discount 30% -> Customer POC price $12,600
- Optional surge / short-term extra capacity (per day): $1,000/day
- Expedited pen-test attestation (signed & courier): $1,200
Payment terms: Net 30. Work begins on signed MSA or PO.
```
I'll pull formal quote from Finance/RevOps and attach an SOW template.

Marta (Security): Add a compliance note in the SOW: "Provided artifacts are redacted summaries and attestation documents. Full internal reports and control logs require an NDA and formal evidence request."

Jackie (Sales): I'll send this. Proposed reply to NewBank (paste below) — please sign off: 

```
Subject: Redwood POC evidence & quote for NewBank

Hi Sam + Legal/Procurement,

Thanks for the checklist. We can provide the following artifacts today or within 48 hours:
- SOC 2 Type II: redacted AOC (available within 6–12 hours)
- ISO 27001: certificate (available within 6–12 hours)
- Pen-test attestation (signed by Redwood CISO; available within 48 hours)
- Network diagram and key-management summary (same-day)

Secure link to artifacts (expires in 14 days): https://artifacts.redwood.com/links/pocevidence/nb-1767777777

Estimated POC cost (draft):
- Dedicated POC (3 weeks, 2x p4d-equivalent): $12,600 (trial discounted)
- Optional surge capacity: $1,000/day
- Expedited attestation support: $1,200

Next steps: please confirm model & expected concurrency for final sizing, and provide billing contact + PO details. If you need full pentest findings, we can share under an NDA — let us know and we'll start that flow.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through technical sizing.

Thanks,
Jackie (Redwood Sales)
```

Devon (Eng): LGTM, add a short bullet that logs/endpoint-level artifacts are not included unless NDA is in place.

Marta (Security): +1. Ready to sign attestation once Jackie confirms the customer email and CCs legal@newbank.com.

Jackie (Sales): Sending now. I'll include the artifact link and ask for billing contact. CCing you all. :thumbsup: 

Alex (Solutions): Sending quote to finance now, will attach formal PDF in the thread when done.

sec-bot: Notification: message sent to artifacts channel and expiry scheduled.

Jackie (Sales): Thanks team — will update thread with customer reply.
